# GrowSimple — Independent Investing Guides for Canadians

> GrowSimple is not a financial advisor. All information is for educational purposes only. We may earn commissions from referral or affiliate links at no additional cost to users. Our editorial policy ensures independence, accuracy, and transparency in every piece of content.
